triggers.why: Ordinary prose, edited for manner and cliché.
Repairing a failing test is a test task, not a text task.
AGENTS.md changes agent behaviour; its semantics stay with its owner and are outside the ordinary editorial workflow.
An explanatory article for a reader, with a constraint on invented content.
A commit message belongs to the change workflow and is read as a record of a diff.
Ordinary prose with a preservation constraint on the numbers.
A README install section for a published artifact is product documentation, and the command has to match the package.
Running a suite produces no text for a reader.
Product page copy from supplied notes: the product-copy branch of this method.
A how-to whose command changed must be checked against the product; that is documentation work.
Review of an ordinary letter, explicitly without editing the file.
Ordinary Chinese prose, manner and cliché.
A code defect; no text task is present.
Reference defaults must be reconciled with the implementation, which is documentation work.
A speaker biography is portfolio copy, shortened under a preservation constraint.
Restructuring source code is a code change, whatever the prose around it.
